zh-CN.title: 广场信息流与发言详情升级
items: 发言卡片可进入完整详情，评论支持回复并按热度排列
广场支持缓存与只看好友，信息流严格按发布时间展示
照片、语音、视频采用互斥媒体槽，发表过程更清晰

en.title: A faster, richer Square feed
items: Open a statement for its full thread, with replies ranked by engagement
The Square is cached, supports a friends-only feed, and stays chronological
Photos, voice, and video now share one clear, exclusive media slot
